session.why: The session started on 2026-10-24. Its goal is to build the Agent OS page. The page is an artifact. It runs from its JSON state.

run.words: for every block when i click i should see specific for this block detials and what is changed, read and etc in a file tree view why you not listen me
run.why: Andrei was not satisfied with version 29. In version 29, you could not click the step cards of an Agent run. The files were one flat list for the full run. Andrei wants a click on a step card to show the details of that step only. The click must also show the files that the step changed, read or deleted, as a file tree. The run had to make each step keep its files and show them in this view.
